purpose: Teach: レフ/栄養素/ボーイング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、撮影スタジオのレフ板、つまりレフ反射板を新調しろ
lines.en: Have the photo studio's reflector boards replaced — the refs, I mean the reflector panels.
lines.style: Clipped authoritative open; low even pitch, each word placed deliberately, zero warmth wasted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員食堂の栄養素バランスを管理します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll keep the staff cafeteria's nutrient balance under proper management.
lines.style: Prompt crisp acknowledgment; steady mid-pace, dutiful tone carrying faint end-of-week fatigue.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外出張はボーイング機を選択しろ
lines.en: For overseas business trips, this company books Boeing aircraft. See to it.
lines.style: Flat directive weight; measured pace, slight firming on the airline choice, expecting instant compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報用ボーイング社製機材の撮影日程を調整します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll coordinate the shoot schedule for the Boeing-made equipment in the PR materials.
lines.style: Brisk note-taking cadence; slightly quicker delivery, confirming details aloud, controlled and cooperative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員食堂の栄養素表を全店舗で標準化しろ
lines.en: And have the cafeteria's nutrient charts standardized across every one of our locations.
lines.style: Final directive with closing-a-folder finality; slow, low, quietly conclusive on the last word.
